in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemaprabha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of Love, Prosperity, and Wisdom. Derived from the Sanskrit words 'hema' (gold) and 'prabha' (light or prosperity).

vedic_reference.note: Hema means gold or wealth and Prabha means light or radiance. The name Hema Prabha is derived from the Hindu goddess of wealth, Lakshmi, who is described as having a golden complexion and a radiant form.
